reconstruction_notes.en: Original positive-cast bed-sole slab deliberately shown sole-face-up for teaching. Six aligned rounded spoon-like raised forms grade into thinner pointed tails and merge continuously with neutral-gray substrate. SERC/NAGT sole-mark description consulted; unavailable inherited USGS PDFs retained without full-read claims. Nominal0.60m span, relief depths, spacing and orientation are original art choices. No excavated specimen replica, animal footprints, random pebbles, negative furrows, exact paleoflow measurement or process simulation.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 原创正凸模层底岩板，教学展示主动将层底朝上。六个同向圆匙状隆起渐变为较薄尖尾，与中性灰基底连续。已查SERC/NAGT层底构造说明；原USGS PDF访问受限如实保留，不声称已读全文。0.60米名义片区、浮雕深度、间距及方向为原创美术设定。不复制出土标本，不作动物足迹、随机卵石或凹沟，不主张精确古流向测定或过程模拟。

claim_scope: Original stylized geological/mineral/process concept, not exact site reconstruction or a named organism.

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
